verdict.rationale: Angular's official GitHub README points developers to an upgrade guide for upgrading their project. The CLI docs back this with a first-party `ng update` command that "Updates your workspace and its dependencies" and links to the Update Guide. Missing for 10: the guide's actual content (version-by-version steps, migration details) is not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation that following it successfully moves a project to a newer version.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow an official upgrade guide to move my existing project to a newer version

citations.quote: Check out our upgrade guide to find out the best way to upgrade your project.
Updates your workspace and its dependencies. See the Update Guide.
